attributes.cardDescription: Instance of an onboarding checklist: tracks completion status for tasks from a template, linked to either an Employee or Contractor
attributes.readMe:
# Onboarding Checklist

## Summary
An instance of a onboarding checklist that tracks concrete progress for either an Employee or Contractor. Spawned from an OnboardingTemplate, with each task's due date computed from the template's relative duration plus the checklist's creation date. Tasks track completion status (pending vs. complete) and who is assigned to complete them.

## Fields
- `employee` (linksTo Employee) — the employee being onboarded. Mutually exclusive with `contractor`.
- `contractor` (linksTo Contractor) — the contractor being onboarded. Mutually exclusive with `employee`.
- `template` (linksTo OnboardingTemplate) — the template this checklist was based on.
- `tasks` (containsMany OnboardingChecklistTaskField) — concrete task instances with completion state.
- `status` (computed) — Not-started → In-progress → Complete based on task completion.
- `createdDate` (DateField) — when the checklist was created.
- `personName` (computed StringField) — DENORMALIZED copy of the linked employee/contractor's name. Why it exists: the fitted format is served as prerendered HTML by the index, and prerendered fitted does not resolve linksTo — so the fitted template reads this own-attribute instead of walking `employee`/`contractor`. computeVia runs at index time, when the links ARE loaded, so the copy stays correct.
- `completedDate` (DateField, optional) — when the checklist was fully completed.
- `title` (computed) — "{Name}'s Onboarding" or "Team Onboarding — Started {date}".

## OnboardingChecklistTaskField
Each task in a checklist is an OnboardingChecklistTaskField: `title`, `dueDate` (computed from template offset + checklist.createdDate), `assignee` (linksTo Employee), `status` (pending|complete), `completedDate` (optional), and `notes`.

## Import
```ts
import { OnboardingChecklist, OnboardingChecklistTaskField, OnboardingChecklistStatusField } from './onboarding-checklist';
```

## Formats

**Isolated:** Header with person avatar + name + overall status pill. Main panel is a task list with a progress bar showing completion percentage. Each task card shows title, status pill (pending/complete), assignee, due date, and notes. Tasks are read-only in this format — mutation is handled by CompleteOnboardingTaskCommand and AssignOnboardingTaskCommand (invoked as AI-assistant tools or programmatically, not by buttons in the card template).

**Embedded:** Compact. Person avatar + name in left column, progress bar + percentage in right column. Used in search results and galleries.

**Fitted:** Minimal responsive card. Person name at top (read from the denormalized `personName`, since prerendered fitted cannot resolve the employee/contractor link), progress percentage badge at bottom. Responsive tier stacking as container shrinks.

**Atom:** Person name + status pill. Used in inline references.

## Usage — three or more ways this is used

**1. As the new-hire progress tracker.** HR/managers open Dana Kim's checklist to see that laptop setup and code access are done, sprint planning is in progress, and pair programming is pending. Completion percentage shows at a glance.

**2. As the contractor onboarding audit trail.** Sarah Chen's checklist records when each task was completed and by whom, creating a contract-compliance record. The template version (sales-onboarding) was in effect at creation time, so audits can compare actual vs. planned.

**3. As the Talent & Resource Tracker's Onboarding tab.** The tracker does NOT link checklists via linksToMany — it runs a live `getCards` query for active checklists and renders them through `@context.searchResultsComponent` as a prerendered fitted grid/strip, so a checklist created by ApproveOfferCommand appears without touching the tracker card.

**4. As the team cohort view.** Multiple checklists (all 2026-Q3 new hires) are displayed fitted in a grid, giving leadership a bird's-eye view of team integration progress.

## Validation & Constraints
- Exactly ONE of `employee` or `contractor` must be set. (Documented as "operator responsibility" for Phase B; Phase C will add custom validation if needed.)
- Task status values are predefined: pending|complete.
- Due dates are computed; they cannot be edited after checklist creation.

## Reuse notes
- Reuses the OnboardingTemplate to define the task structure.
- Integrates with Employee and Contractor (both are updated by hiring commands in Phase A/B).
- OnboardingChecklistStatusField is shared with the status pill rendering.
- Mutation commands exist: CreateOnboardingChecklistCommand spawns a checklist from a template (auto-invoked by ApproveOfferCommand on hire), CompleteOnboardingTaskCommand marks a task done and rolls up checklist status, AssignOnboardingTaskCommand sets a task's assignee.

## Examples
- `OnboardingChecklist/dana-kim-onboarding` — Dana Kim (Employee) mid-onboarding, 3 of 7 tasks complete; demonstrates the in-progress status roll-up, per-task assignee links, and the progress bar.
- `OnboardingChecklist/sarah-chen-onboarding` — Sarah Chen (Contractor) with 2 of 4 tasks complete; demonstrates the contractor branch of the employee/contractor exclusivity rule.
OnboardingChecklistTaskField has no Spec of its own — this Spec covers it, and the populated `tasks` arrays on both linked examples (with status, completedDate, and assignee links) are its contained examples in use.

**Non-goals:** Task reordering, task deletion, template versioning within a checklist. These are handled by creating a new checklist from a different template version.
